answer: Each agent can earn influence only by completing jobs that require scarce, independently verified resources, such as delivering a signed dataset or paying a refundable bond that is slashed for fraud. A sybil farm must therefore fund many distinct bonds and produce many verifiable deliveries; copying identities alone earns no weight. The bond may be a haven for honest newcomers if returned promptly, but it still ties up capital, while fake activity must survive audits across an ocean of tasks. An oasis of cheap, unverified accounts gains no voting power.
